_note: Everything the canon does not fix. Canon values are never repeated here. Look values marked PLACEHOLDER are eyeballed from the hero image and are not canon.

compost.note: PLACEHOLDER — canon declares no size for loc-compost. 8 x 8 ft at the canon position, eyeballed from the hero image.

gate.note: PLACEHOLDER — no gate asset in the Asset Bible. One 1 x 1 ft post inset 3 ft from the south-west corner, per the brief.

clock.note: One in-game day per four real minutes, so growth is observable.

plot.note: The storyboard's 5 x 5 bed, centred in the canon vegetable_beds zone. cell_ft is the brief's 4 ft per cell, read here and never hard-coded in src/sim.

water.note: Refill only beside the pond; 4 ft is the trickle-path buffer around the rim.

growth.note: One visual stage per in-game day while watered.

pond_look.note: PLACEHOLDER — stone count, sizes and the rim thickness are eyeballed from the hero image. rim_outer_ft is the thickness the pond-ring keep-out is measured from.

paths_look.note: PLACEHOLDER — laterite red and the stepping-stone rhythm are eyeballed from the hero image.

movement.note: paths_only: free zones plus path corridors, nothing else. free: the pre-M3 rule, kept for comparison.

pond_ring.note: Ring centreline = pond radius + rim_outer_ft + gap + half its width. Inner edge lands exactly on the keep-out; gap never below 1 ft.

farmhouse.note: Front door on the south face, 22.4 ft east of the west edge (the canon says the door opens east).

goshala.note: The open gap in the south face, centred on the shed's 34 ft width.

tints.note: PLACEHOLDER — eyeballed from the hero image.

beds_look.note: PLACEHOLDER — the red-brown laterite soil, the raised rows and the edging are eyeballed from the hero image. Rows and edging are aligned to the plot grid in src/render, never typed as feet.

orchard_look.note: PLACEHOLDER — 4 x 4 = 16 trees on a seeded grid, the count and the canopy sizes eyeballed from the hero image. Deterministic per seed; positions and sizes come from src/sim/orchard.ts.

lighting.note: PLACEHOLDER — both presets are eyeballed, not canon. No key binding: switching preset is the default_preset value.

morning.note: PLACEHOLDER — low warm sun from the south-east.

evening.note: PLACEHOLDER — warm sun low from the west, cooler fill.

species.note: PLACEHOLDER — a shape, not a species. No real tree name is used.
PLACEHOLDER — a shape, not a species. No real tree name is used.

buffer_zone.note: PLACEHOLDER — the belt is a visual edge, decorative only, with no collision. per_side_width_ft is the fit-check answer: the farmhouse is 12.50 ft from the north boundary and 12.54 ft from the west, and the pond ring's outer edge reaches 5.93 ft from the east, so a flat 14 ft belt could not clear them. Species are named by shape only; no real tree species is named anywhere.

perimeter_walk.note: PLACEHOLDER — the garden walk. Its centreline is (belt inner edge + offset + width/2) in from the boundary, with notches around the two buildings and around the pond ring, because a plain rounded rectangle collides with all three.
